It's definitely a topic with strong arguments on both sides, and I can see why people—especially those who've found great communities or professional opportunities through it—view it as a net positive. 

That said, I'm not inclined to change my view just because it's the minority one in your circle. When I look at the broader picture, the systemic effects on mental health, the erosion of shared reality through algorithmic polarization, and the way it fragments our attention seem to outweigh the benefits of easier connection. Reasonable people can weigh those trade-offs differently, though. What makes the people you've talked to feel so confident that it's been a net positive?
